informal_theorems.outline: BCS knowledge error is asymptotically bounded using PQ state-restoration knowledge error and commitment multi-extractability error.
For k rounds and t quantum moves, the stated RBR-to-state-restoration loss is O((t+k)^2); knowledge soundness uses the relaxed RBR knowledge property.
Merkle commitment PQ extractability is stated as O(t^3/2^sigma) for an ideal sigma-bit-output oracle; this is a commitment property.
